name: Airport Authority Hong Kong
subsector: airport operator and airport city developer
desc: Government-owned statutory body that operates Hong Kong International Airport and develops its retail, real-estate, exhibition and SKYTOPIA airport-city assets.
products: airport operations, retail licences and advertising, real estate, AsiaWorld-Expo convention venue
parent_immediate: Government of the Hong Kong SAR
parent_ultimate: Government of the Hong Kong SAR
marketing_autonomy_basis: statutory body with its own board, management and commercial partnerships (e.g. Yacht Club de Monaco collaboration)
markets: Hong Kong hub serving Asia-Pacific and long-haul networks; Greater Bay Area airport-city development

fin.value_orig: HKD 3,588m operating profit before depreciation and amortisation (six months to 30 Sep 2026)
HKD 724m profit for the period (six months to 30 Sep 2026)

profitability_basis: HKD 724m profit for the six months to 30 Sep 2026 (interim report)
